subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Which permanent Telegram album API should OpenClaw support for outbound multi-media sends?
rationale: The missing capability is source-backed, but choosing between album semantics on existing mediaUrls paths and a new send-media-group/filePaths action changes the model-facing API and cross-path delivery contract.

options.title: Use existing mediaUrls semantics
options.body: Add sendMediaGroup as a Telegram delivery optimization for existing structured multi-media payloads and keep sequential fallback for unsupported cases.

options.title: Adopt the draft action
options.body: Review and reshape the external draft's send-media-group/filePaths surface as the supported Telegram album action contract.

options.title: Defer native albums
options.body: Keep sequential media fanout as the supported behavior and document that Telegram albums are not currently guaranteed.

recommendation.title: Use existing mediaUrls semantics
recommendation.body: Add sendMediaGroup as a Telegram delivery optimization for existing structured multi-media payloads and keep sequential fallback for unsupported cases.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already framed this issue as a maintainer cleanup/API-shape decision across Telegram send surfaces.
